_: Where a character lands on crossing a border into a map, where a capture has measured it.
The server mirrors the cell the character left from across the border, which holds between
maps that really touch. Where they do not, the landing is written here and wins.
THE GUIDED TUTORIAL. Its rooms are islands: walking off the right edge of one loads the next
(the client asks for the id beside it, 241437697, and the real server answers 241438721), and
the capture of the whole tutorial puts the character on cell 84 facing 1 in every room it
crosses into, its jss each time.
«from» names the map the character comes from, for a room entered from both sides; without
it the arrival holds for whatever arrival the others do not name, teleports included.
THE CELESTIAL TEMPLE. Its three rooms are islands too, joined corner to corner: the
Dofusarium's right edge is its bottom-right corner (cells 419-503), the next room's left
edge its top-left corner (56-112) and its right edge its bottom-right (447-503), the exit
room's left edge its top-left (56-112) -- the mapChangeData of the client's cells. Mirrored
across, the cell left from lands in the middle of the next room or off its floor. Walking
in, the tutorial's cell 84 facing 1, the middle of the left edge; walking back, the middle
